name: aimiru
description: Checks each action Claude Code takes against your limits in Aimiru before it runs, holds its next step while you pause, and records what happened.

agent_key.title: Aimiru key for Claude Code
agent_key.description: Paste the key you were given, from the demo page or from Aimiru, under Agents, Add an agent, Claude Code. It starts with sayso_agt_. Restart Claude Code after saving it. With an Aimiru account you can leave this empty and run /aimiru:connect instead: you pick a code on your phone and the key never needs copying.

sayso_url.title: Aimiru address
sayso_url.description: The address shown next to your key in Aimiru, starting with https://, without a slash at the end. When it is empty, /aimiru:connect uses https://aimiru.app.
